summary: Excellent code quality. Workflow uses pinned actions (v4), least-privilege permissions, and proper shell config. PowerShell scripts follow all conventions: Set-StrictMode, -ErrorActionPreference Stop, quoted variables, LiteralPath for I/O, proper error handling. Module exports are explicit. Functions are pure, testable, and well-separated by concern. Documentation is comprehensive with comment-based help blocks explaining WHY (e.g., record-separator trick, PowerShell array handling quirk). Zero code duplication. No dead code. Regex patterns for conventional commits and version validation are correct. Changelog generation is clean with proper grouping. No critical issues; design enables future downstream steps (commit/push) if needed via workflow composition.
